findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "screenshot_url" references sensitive artifacts (credentials, cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "web" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: shorten_url, fetch_site_logo, fetch_page_metadata · Private data: shorten_url, screenshot_url · Public sink: fetch_site_logo · Destructive: screenshot_url, fetch_site_logo.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: shorten_url, fetch_site_logo, fetch_page_metadata · Private data: shorten_url, screenshot_url · Public sink: fetch_site_logo · Destructive: screenshot_url, fetch_site_logo

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
